 *****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Pursuant to Executive N-29-20 and
given the current health concerns, members of the public can access meetings live on-line,
  with audio and limited video, at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/ and on
  Spectrum Cable Channel 35. In addition, members of the public can submit comments
electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by
sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City
  Clerk at aphillips@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the
  Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to
  12:00 P.M. the day of the meeting. Those comments, as well as any comments received
after 12:00 P.M., will be distributed to the members of the Legislative Body and will be made
 part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-
  412-5280 with any questions.

 ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in
 appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and
  regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-
 related modification or accommodation, in order to observe and/or offer public comment
 may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, aid, or service by contacting
  the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280 or via email to
yhorton@cityofingelwood.org no later than 10:00 AM on the day of the scheduled meeting.

Inglewood, California
  April 21, 2020

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
  April 21, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:02 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales
  and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Butts
  inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
  Closed Session Items.

  There was no response.

  Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:03 p.m. for Closed Session Item
  Nos. CS-1, CS-2, and CS-3.

  *****************

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
  hour of 2:03 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority
  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agenda.
  There was no response.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by

  1
 April 21, 2020

  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales that
  the demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  April 10, 2020, in the amount of $4,934,507.85 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 132  CLAIMS DENIED. Letters from the Office of the City Attorney recommending the
  following:
  A. Return Late Claim filed pursuant to Government Code Section 911.2:
  1) Karen L. Peterkin for alleged property damage on June 30, 2019.

  B. Deny Application for Leave to Present a Late Claim pursuant to Government
  Code Section 911.6:
  1) Carolyn E. Terry for alleged personal injury on May 8, 2018

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, seconded by Council Member Dotson that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Return late claim listed as A1; 2) Deny application for
  leave to present a late claim listed as B1. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 171  PAYMENT AUTHORIZED – CREATIVE BUS SALES. Staff report dated April 21,
  2020, was presented recommending authorization to pay Creative Bus Sales for
  accessories including branding and radio equipment for two replacement paratransit
  vehicles purchased through the Section 5310 Enhanced Mobility of Seniors and
  Individuals with Disabilities Program Grant.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby authorize payment in the amount of $8,954. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None

 183  AWARD OF CONTRACT AND AGREEMENT NO. 20-182 APPROVED – JOHN
  L. HUNTER AND ASSOCIATES, INC. Staff report dated April 21, 2020, was
  presented recommending award of contract and approval of a three-year agreement to
  John L. Hunter and Associates, Inc., for as-needed Professional Services for National
  Pollutant Discharge and Elimination System (NPDES).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby Award contract and approve Agreement No. 20-182 in
  the annual amount of $102,850 (total agreement amount of $308,550). The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 183  AWARD OF CONTRACTS AND AGREEMENT NOS. 20-183 AND 20-184
  APPROVED – STEPHEN DORECK EQUIPMENT RENTALS, INC., AND J.A.
  SALAZAR CONSTRUCTION AND SUPPLY CORPORATION. Staff report dated
  April 21, 2020, was presented recommending award of contracts and approval of two (2)
  two-year agreements for on-call water system services, per Bid No. RFP-0140.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Award contract and approve Agreement No. 20-183
  with Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc., in the annual amount of $200,000 (total
  agreement amount of $400,000); and 2) Award contract and approve Agreement No. 20-

  2
 April 21, 2020

  184 with J. A. Salazar Construction and Supply Corporation in the annual amount of
  $200,000 (total agreement amount of $400,000). The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 103.1  AMENNDMENT NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 19-208 APPROVED – THE
  JONES PAYNE GROUP, INC. Staff report dated April 21, 2020, was presented
  recommending approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 19-208 with The Jones
  Payne Group, Inc., extending the term to October 31, 2020, to complete Acoustical
  Testing Services for the Residential Sound Insulation Program.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby approve Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 19-208.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 103.1  AWARD OF CONTRACT AND AGREEMENT NO. 20-185 APPROVED - HHJ
  CONSTRUCTION INC.; RESOLUTION NO. 20-60 ADOPTED – AMENDING
  THE 2019-2020 FISCAL YEAR BUDGET. Staff report dated April 21, 2020, was
  presented recommending award of contract and approval of an agreement with HHJ
  Construction Inc., to provide residential sound insulation work on 48 residential units, per
  Bid No. CB-20-03.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Award contract and approve Agreement No. 20-185
  in the amount of $1,501,363 (includes 10% contingency fund in the amount of $134,800,
  and special expenses in the amount of $18,563); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 20-60
  entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2019/2020 ANNUAL
  BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 183  AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO AGREEMENT NO. 16-016 APPROVED – PSOMAS.
  Staff report dated April 21, 2020, was presented recommending approval of Amendment
  No. 2 to Agreement No. 16-016 with PSOMAS extending the term of the agreement by
  an additional year to continue providing construction management services for the
  Century Boulevard Mobility Improvement Project, Phase 1 and 2.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member Dotson that the City Council/Successor
  Agency does hereby: 1) Approve Amendment No 2 to Agreement No. 16-016; and 2)
  Approve the use of ROPS funding in the amount of $422,252 (new total contract amount
  not to exceed $5,253,688). The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Member Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin,
  and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 301  PUBLIC HEARING NOT SET – ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE ELEMENT OF
  THE GENERAL PLAN.

  This item was pulled from the Agenda.

  3
 April 21, 2020

 301  PUBLIC HEARING NOT SET – CLAIRFICATION EXSISTING POPULATION
  DENSITY AND BUILDING INTENSITY ALLOWANCE FOR ALL LAND USE
  DESIGNATIONS.

  This item was pulled from the Agenda.

 127.1  Council Initiative:

  James T. Butts, Jr. –

  EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 4 - FACE COVERING WHILE IN PUBLIC AND
  PRIVATE SPACES. Initiative by Mayor James T. Butts, Jr., mandating all persons in
  the City of Inglewood wear a face covering when interacting in public and private spaces
  with others who are not members of their household, pursuant to Executive Order No. 4
  dated April 8, 2020.

  It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Morales that the City
  Council does hereby ratify and approve Executive Order No. 4. The motion was carried
  by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL; NAME OF
  CASE; WYNDEL WINANS V. CITY OF INGLEWOOD, ET AL; LASC CASE
  NO. BC098323. Closed session – Confidential – Attorney/Client Privileged; Conference
  with Legal Counsel regarding Pending Litigation Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(1); Name of Case: Wyndel Winans v. City of Inglewood, et al.; LASC Case
  No. BC698323.

  Disussion held; Direction given to staff.

  Inglewood, et al.; USDC Case No.: 2:19-cv-06813 SVW.

  Discussion held; Direction given to staff.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL; NAME OF
  CASE; ASUCION JAUREGUI V. CITY OF INGLEWOOD, ET AL.; LASC CASE

  Conference with Legal Counsel regarding Pending Litigation Pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956.9(d)(1); Name of Case: Asuncion Jauregui v. City of Inglewood, et
  al.; LASC Case No. 19STCV15098.

  Discussion held; Direction given to staff.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not

  Public comment was received via email from Ms. Susan Janson, and will be filed in the
  record.

  COUNCIL REMARKS – COUNCIL MEBMER FRANKLIN. Council Member
  Franklin commented that he will be presenting Ms. Linsey Smith with a proclamation for
  turning 100 years old.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 2:11 p.m.
